name: warp-background
title: Warp Background
description: A card background drawn as a 3D perspective grid tunnel, with coloured light beams racing from the edges toward the centre on looping timers.
use: A card or panel should feel like it is travelling forward, such as a launch or sci-fi theme.
avoid: Content-led pages: the busy tunnel and bright beams compete with text.
a11y: The animated backdrop is decorative with no focusable parts; the endless motion ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark tunnel of nested rectangular grid outlines receding to a vanishing point, crossed by angled coloured light streaks in green, purple, blue and orange. A small panel of text sits in the middle.
behaves: Beams shoot from the outer edges toward the centre on repeating loops, each with its own random hue, delay and speed, while the grid tunnel itself stays still.
customise: Perspective depth, beams per side, beam width, delay range, duration and grid colour are props; beam hues are random in the source.
weight: moderate: A dozen motion-driven beams plus a CSS 3D grid; continuous but few nodes.
